extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, parties appearing before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (attorneys, agents, and litigants)
extracted.subtask_description: An index of policies, procedures, rules, guidance memoranda, SOPs, rulemaking notices, and reference materials governing proceedings before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (trials, appeals, institution, and related processes). Useful for practitioners preparing or defending AIA trials, ex parte appeals, reexaminations, and other PTAB matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules for ex parte appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing ex parte appeals before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Appeals → Ex parte appeals; provides procedural requirements for filing and prosecuting ex parte appeals to the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for oral arguments (appeals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for requesting oral argument in appeal proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates how and when a party may request oral argument in ex parte appeal proceedings before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim construction final rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Final rule setting forth how claim construction is performed in PTAB proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to AIA trials and affects how claims are interpreted for institution, trial, and final written decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AIA trial proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: General materials and rules relating to trials under the America Invents Act (AIA), including IPR, PGR, and derivation processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top-level guidance for institution, conduct, and disposition of AIA post-grant proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules for AIA trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules of practice that govern trials under the AIA before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedural rules (such as timing, motions, evidence, and practice) applicable to IPR, PGR, and derivation proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Umbrella rules
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level rules that apply across multiple PTAB proceeding types (umbrella rules).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as cross-cutting procedural framework referenced by specific trial rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inter partes review
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials and rules specific to inter partes review (IPR) proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes institution standards, petitioning, responses, evidence, and briefing specific to IPRs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-grant review
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials and rules specific to post-grant review (PGR) proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers filing, institution, and trial procedures unique to PGRs (e.g., grounds based on patentability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Derivation
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials and rules governing derivation proceedings under the AIA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines standards and procedures for alleging that an inventor derived the claimed invention from another.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice regarding options for amendments through reissues or reexaminations
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice describing options for amending patents through reissue or reexamination as an alternative to PTAB amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains alternatives to motion-to-amend practice in PTAB proceedings and procedural considerations (listed April 19, 2019).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial Practice Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive practice guide for PTAB trial practitioners outlining procedures, best practices, and expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Web version available; provides practitioner guidance beyond bare rules for presenting petitions, responses, evidence, motions, and hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated trial practice guide (December 2025 web)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidated and updated web version of the Trial Practice Guide as of December 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents an integrated practice guidance document consolidating prior guidance and practice tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial Practice Guide Archive
rubrics_metrics.description: Archived versions of the Trial Practice Guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides historical or superseded practice guidance for reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules of inter partes reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing inter partes reexamination proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicable to older reexamination practice and provides procedural requirements for contested reexaminations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules for contested cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules that apply to contested cases (appeals and other contested proceedings) before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers procedural standards specific to contested appeals and adjudicatory processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules for interferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing interference proceedings (historical proceeding to determine priority).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirements and practices for interference proceedings (largely historical, pre-AIA).

rubrics_metrics.name: SOP 1 (rev. 16): Assignment of judges to panels
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard operating procedure describing how judges are assigned to decision panels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies internal paneling rules and assignment procedures (rev. 16 as of June 12, 2024).

rubrics_metrics.name: SOP 2 (rev. 11): Designation or de-designation of decisions as precedential or informative
rubrics_metrics.description: SOP setting criteria and procedures for designating Board decisions as precedential or informative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes internal process for identifying and formally designating decisions (rev. 11, July 24, 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: SOP 2 (rev. 11) Addendum
rubrics_metrics.description: Addendum to SOP 2 providing supplemental directions or updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued August 12, 2025; modifies/clarifies aspects of precedential/informative designation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOP 3 (rev. 2, formerly SOP9): Procedure for Decisions Remanded from the Federal Circuit for Further Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure governing how the PTAB handles decisions remanded from the Federal Circuit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides internal processes for remand handling (rev. 2, Oct 5, 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: SOP 4 (rev. 1): Procedure for Pre-Issuance Optional Decision Review and Post-Issuance Decision Review
rubrics_metrics.description: SOP establishing procedures for optional internal review of decisions before issuance and after issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out review pathways and internal timelines (rev. 1, Oct 5, 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance Memorandum for the Ex Parte Appeals Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance memorandum describing procedures for processing ex parte appeals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides internal and external guidance on ex parte appeal handling and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOP: Processing Procedures for Ex Parte Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal operating procedures for processing ex parte appeals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed processing steps and workflows for ex parte appeal docketing and handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processes and Guidance Memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: General processes and guidance memoranda used by the PTAB to explain or clarify practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category header for various procedural memos; includes topic-specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Discretionary Institution Considerations – U.S. Manufacturing and Small Business Use of AIA Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on additional discretionary considerations for institution decisions, specifically addressing U.S. manufacturing and small business use of AIA proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued March 11, 2026; explains how certain policy considerations can factor into institution discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary Search Disclosure Declarations as a Favorable Factor in Institution Decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Memorandum indicating that voluntary search disclosure declarations may be considered favorably in institution decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued November 17, 2025; provides a policy lever where a voluntary search disclosure can positively affect institution determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precedential designation of Corning Optical Communications RF, LLC v. PPC Broadband Inc. (IPR2014-00440, Paper 68)
rubrics_metrics.description: Designation of a specific Board decision as precedential (except for § II.E.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued October 28, 2025; identifies decision-specific precedent and its scope of applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director Institution of AIA Trial Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance or notice regarding the Director’s institution authority or actions for AIA trial proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued October 17, 2025; addresses Director-level institution considerations or exercises of discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: PTAB consideration of prior findings of fact and conclusions of law
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when and how the PTAB will consider prior findings of fact and conclusions of law in later proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued September 16, 2025; clarifies treatment of prior determinations in subsequent cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement and Non-waiver of 37 C.F.R. § 42.104(b)(4) and Permissible Uses of General Knowledge in Inter Partes Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Memorandum addressing enforcement and non-waiver of a specific rule regarding evidentiary uses of general knowledge and related procedural enforcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued July 31, 2025; discusses permissible use of general knowledge and enforcement of 37 C.F.R. § 42.104(b)(4).

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Written Decision Procedures for AIA Trial Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural guidance concerning issuance and processing of final written decisions in AIA trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued July 29, 2025; addresses internal practices and procedures that govern final written decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interim Processes for PTAB Workload Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Interim procedures established to manage PTAB workload.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued March 26, 2025; provides temporary or transitional processes to handle caseload pressures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance on USPTO’s recission of 'Interim Procedure for Discretionary Denials in AIA Post-Grant Proceedings with Parallel District Court Litigation'
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance describing the USPTO's rescission of a prior interim procedure concerning discretionary denials when parallel district court litigation exists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued March 24, 2025; explains effect and rationale for recission.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Applicability of Existing Regulations as to Party and Practitioner Misconduct Related to the Use of Artificial Intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how existing regulations apply to misconduct by parties or practitioners involving use of AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued February 6, 2024; addresses ethical and rule-enforcement considerations when AI is used in PTAB proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance on Paneling of Cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how cases are paneled for decision (assignment of judges, panel composition policies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued September 22, 2023; clarifies paneling practices and considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated applicant admitted prior art (AAPA) memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated memorandum addressing the treatment of applicant-admitted prior art in PTAB proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued June 9, 2022; supersedes earlier AAPA guidance (note: supersession referenced).

rubrics_metrics.name: Indefiniteness in AIA post-grant proceedings memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: Memorandum addressing how indefiniteness is treated in AIA post-grant proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued January 6, 2021; clarifies standards and approaches to indefiniteness arguments at the PTAB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant admitted prior art (AAPA) memorandum (August 18, 2020)
rubrics_metrics.description: Earlier memorandum on applicant-admitted prior art principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued August 18, 2020; later superseded by updated AAPA memorandum (June 9, 2022).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutes, rules, and references — Title 35 of the United States Code
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation and reliance on Title 35 U.S.C. as the statutory framework for patent law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary substantive statutory source for patentability, remedies, and related issues referenced by PTAB rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutes, rules, and references — 37 CFR
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation and reliance on Title 37 of the Code of Federal Regulations (rules of practice before the USPTO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains specific PTAB rules of practice (e.g., §§ 42.xx) and procedural regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutes, rules, and references — Federal Rules of Evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to the Federal Rules of Evidence as applicable to PTAB proceedings where relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides admissibility and reliability of evidence presented at the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent proposals, pilot programs, and final rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Presentations of recent rule proposals, pilot programs, and finalized rule changes affecting PTAB practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all for dynamic rulemaking and experimental procedural changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to the MPEP as a procedural and substantive examiner manual relevant to patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for understanding prosecution history and examiner practice that may intersect with PTAB proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: USPTO Rules of Professional Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethics rules governing practitioner conduct before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets professional responsibility obligations for attorneys and agents practicing before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: General ethics guidance applicable to PTAB practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses professional conduct, conflicts, and other ethical issues in PTAB proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. Supreme Court
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to U.S. Supreme Court decisions as controlling law that may affect PTAB practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PTAB decisions and practice may be informed or constrained by relevant Supreme Court precedents.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (CAFC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to CAFC decisions as influential or controlling precedents for PTAB decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PTAB decisions are often appealed to and guided by CAFC precedent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking — Expanding Opportunities to Appear Before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking initiative to expand opportunities to appear before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed or final rule (Oct 10, 2024) that changes who may appear or the manner of appearance before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking — Rules Governing Director Review of Patent Trial and Appeal Board Decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking establishing or modifying the process for Director review of PTAB decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued Oct 1, 2024; governs procedures for seeking Director review of Board decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking — Rules Governing Motion to Amend Practice and Procedures in Trial Proceedings under the America Invents Act before the PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking addressing motions to amend in AIA trial proceedings, including practice and procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued Sept 18, 2024; affects how motions to amend claims are handled in IPR/PGR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking — Rules Governing Pre-Issuance Internal Circulation and Review of Decisions Within the PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking governing the internal circulation and review of PTAB decisions prior to issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued June 12, 2024; establishes processes for pre-issuance internal review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking — Notice of Proposed Rulemaking on PTAB Rules of Practice for Briefing Discretionary Denial Issues, and Rules for 325(d) Considerations, Instituting Parallel and Serial Petitions, and Termination Due to Settlement Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rulemaking addressing a suite of practice issues including discretionary denials, 325(d) considerations, parallel/serial petitions, and termination for settlement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued April 19, 2024; outlines potential changes to institution and petition-handling rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemaking — Advance Notice of Proposed Rulemaking for AIA Proceedings before the PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Advance notice soliciting input on potential rule changes for AIA proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued April 21, 2023; early-stage rulemaking outreach for AIA procedure reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: FAQs — Voluntary Search Disclosure Declaration FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequently asked questions about voluntary search disclosure declarations and their effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued Nov 18, 2025; explains process and potential institution benefits of voluntary disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: FAQs — P-TACTS FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: FAQs regarding P-TACTS (PTAB case tracking and tools) and related systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued Mar 20, 2025; addresses operational questions about PTAB IT/tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director Review Process (FAQ/guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about the Director review process for PTAB decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes steps and standards for requesting Director review.

rubrics_metrics.name: PTAB operational FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational frequently asked questions for PTAB processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued May 29, 2020; addresses common procedural and operational questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AIA FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequently asked questions related to AIA proceedings (IPR, PGR, derivation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General guidance for practitioners and parties regarding AIA-specific issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: General PTAB FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: General frequently asked questions about the Patent Trial and Appeal Board and its processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level answers to common questions about PTAB jurisdiction, procedure, and practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive (rescinded) — Interim procedure for discretionary denials in AIA post-grant proceeding with parallel district court litigation memorandum
rubrics_metrics.description: Previously issued interim procedure regarding discretionary denials when there is parallel district court litigation, rescinded Feb 28, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Archived/rescinded memo (originally June 21, 2022); retained for historical reference.
